## Overview

This analysis explores the iris dataset using various visualizations.

```{r}
#| label: load-libraries

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

## Histogram

Visualizing the distribution of sepal lengths:

```{r}
#| label: histogram

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Sepal Length",
       x = "Sepal Length",
       y = "Frequency") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100))
```

## Violin Plot

Comparing petal widths across species:

```{r}
#| label: violin-plot

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Petal.Width, fill = Species)) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(title = "Petal Width Distribution by Species",
       x = "Species"
       y = "Petal Width (cm)") +
  theme_classic()
```

## Data Summary

```{r}
#| label: data-summary

iris %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_sepal_length = mean(Sepal.Length),
    mean_petal_length = mean(Petal.Length),
    max_petal_width = max(Petal.Widht),
    count = n()
  )
```
